headerDisplay: Brings Daikin One+, One Touch and One Lite thermostats into Apple Home through the official Daikin One Cloud Open API. In the Daikin One app, request an integrator token under **Daikin One Care → home integration**, then read the API key from the **developer** menu in the same section. Full walkthrough in the plugin README.
footerDisplay: Daikin rate limits integrations that poll a thermostat more than once every three minutes, so changes made at the wall unit can take up to one polling interval to appear in the Home app. Changes made *from* the Home app are sent immediately.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: From the Daikin One app: Daikin One Care → home integration → developer.

email.title: Daikin Account Email
email.description: The email address the Daikin One app signs in with.

integratorToken.title: Integrator Token
integratorToken.description: From the Daikin One app: Daikin One Care → home integration → get integration token. Must be generated on the account that owns the thermostat.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often each thermostat is read. Daikin's documented floor is 180 seconds; lower values are raised back up to it.

showIndoorHumidity.title: Show indoor humidity on the thermostat

showOutdoorTemperatureSensor.title: Add an outdoor temperature sensor
showOutdoorTemperatureSensor.description: Daikin reports outdoor temperature from the cloud, not from a local sensor.

experimentalScheduleSwitch.title: Add a schedule on/off switch (experimental)
experimentalScheduleSwitch.description: Writes 'scheduleEnabled' alongside the setpoints. Not confirmed against every firmware — check the Homebridge log if the switch fails to move.

experimentalFanSwitch.title: Add a fan circulate switch (experimental)
experimentalFanSwitch.description: Writes 'fanCirculate' alongside the setpoints. Not confirmed against every firmware — check the Homebridge log if the switch fails to move.

baseUrl.title: API Base URL
baseUrl.description: Override only if Daikin moves the Open API endpoint. Defaults to https://integrator-api.daikinskyport.com

debug.title: Verbose logging
debug.description: Logs API activity at info level so it shows up without running Homebridge in debug mode.
